module: Career delivery content generator. On load (setup) it reads the parcel templates (*.deliveryParcels.json), vehicle templates (*.deliveryVehicles.json) and material templates (*.deliveryMaterials.json) in gameplay/delivery/, prepares the facilities (freeroam_facilities of type deliveryProvider: parking spots, provided/received logistic types, material storages, generators, progress), then produces parcels and vehicle/trailer offers and evolves the material stocks according to the generators' intervals. Also provides the computation of distances and initial rewards, and the material operations (splitting, moving, storing).
usage:
local fac = career_modules_delivery_generator.getFacilityById("someFacilityId")
local ps = career_modules_delivery_generator.getParkingSpotByPath(psPath)
local d = career_modules_delivery_generator.getDistanceBetweenFacilities(originLoc, destLoc) -- meters by road
notes: Generator types: parcelProvider, parcelReceiver (parcels), vehOfferProvider, trailerOfferProvider (vehicle/trailer offers), materialProvider, materialReceiver (material stock).
A location is a table {type='facilityParkingspot', facId, psPath}; 'multi' contains several possible destinations.
The generators only run when a request calls triggerAllGenerators (for example the getAllCargo* functions of the parcelManager); a flag limits the call to once per frame (reset to false by onUpdate).
Minimum delivery distance: 150 m (minDeliveryDistance), measured over the road network (map.getPath) plus the distances to the nearest roads; 1 if a position has no road.
Parcel reward: money = (sqrt(slots)/4 + (km)^(1+sqrt(slots)/100) * (5 + weight^0.9)), multiplied by the organization's delivery bonus; XP = base (2, +1 at 16, 32, 64 slots) + rounded km.

Bug: in triggerParcelGenerator, for parcelProvider with multiDestination, psPath is filled by `s:getPath()` where `s` is not defined: would raise a Lua error if this mode is used (it should be ap.psPath).
Bug: setupMaterialStorage fixes a negative stock with `storage.storedVlume = 0` (typo); the negative value is therefore not corrected.
In triggerVehicleOfferGenerator, if no destination facility is found, the function exits entirely (return) instead of moving on to the next offer.
If a vehicleProvider-type generator is tested in createGeneratorTemplateCache, the block is empty; only the parcel code fills validTemplates.
finalizeMaterialDistances does nothing in this version: all the computation is in a commented block.
The commented field M.getLogisticTypesLookup does not exist; the line that references it in the automatic page comes from a code comment.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: freeroam_facilities, gameplay_sites_sitesManager, util_configListGenerator.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the references to the other delivery extensions and util_stepHandler.

setup.desc: Initializes the whole delivery system: loads the material, parcel and vehicle templates, prepares the facilities (setupFacilities), then either reloads the saved parcels and offers (discarding the temporary material cargos 'addMaterialAsParcelToContainer'), or generates an initial stock by simulating past generations (240 s of parcels, 1000 s of vehicle offers).

loadData.desc: Save data: facilities (progress, materialStorages, logisticGenerators), parcels, vehicleOffers, general.maxGroupId.

getFacilities.desc: List of delivery facilities, sorted by translated name.

getFacilityById.desc: Looks up a facility by id.

getParkingSpotByPath.desc: Returns the parking spot (site object) matching an identification path.

getParcelTemplateById.desc: Returns the parcel template loaded from the *.deliveryParcels.json files.

returns.desc: Template (names, slots, weight, modChance, offerDuration, isTutorialParcel…).

getMaterialsTemplatesById.desc: Returns a material's template (*.deliveryMaterials.json): type (fluid/dryBulk), density, money, name…

selectAccessPointByLookupKeyByType.desc: Randomly picks an access point among those that handle a given logistic type; logs an error and prints the list if none fits.

distanceBetween.desc: Road distance between two positions: sum of the segments of the map path (map.getPath) plus the distance to the nearest road of each position.

returns.desc: Distance in meters (1 if one of the positions has no road).

getLocationCoordinates.desc: World position of a location: parking spot for 'facilityParkingspot', vehicle position for 'vehicle'. Other types: prints a message and returns nil.

getDistanceBetweenFacilities.desc: Road distance (cached per origin/destination pair) between two locations. If loc2 is 'multi', returns the (upper) median of the distances to each destination.

returns.desc: Distance in meters (nil for another location type).

finalizeParcelItemDistanceAndRewards.desc: Computes (only once) a parcel's origin distance, its modifiers (dParcelMods.generateModifiers) and its rewards: money, logistics XP, skill XP (logistics-materials or logistics-delivery, +10 for tutorial parcels) and organization reputation (with a delivery bonus according to its level).

item.desc: Cargo (slots, weight, origin, destination, templateId, organization…).

finalizeVehicleOffer.desc: Completes a vehicle offer: picks a random vehicle according to its filter (model, config, mileage, name) if absent, then computes distance and rewards (baseReward + rewardPerKm, logistics XP, vehicle/trailer type XP, reputation).

finalizeMaterialDistances.desc: Intended to compute the nearest providers/receivers of a facility; the body is entirely commented out, so it has no effect.

finalizeMaterialDistanceRewards.desc: Computes the XP of a material delivery according to distance and number of slots, writes it into rewards.logistics and rewards['logistics-materials'], as well as the organization reputation and the money bonus.

addMaterialAsParcelToContainer.desc: Creates a material cargo (merge=true, offer without expiration, 'multi' destinations: facilities that receive this material) from a facility's stock, and schedules its transient move to the vehicle's container.

sourcePsPath.desc: Fallback spot if no supplier access point is found.

splitOffPartsFromMaterialCargo.desc: Splits a material cargo: creates copies of given sizes and reduces the original accordingly (weight and money recomputed).

otherPartSizes.desc: Sizes (slots) of the parts to split off.

returns.desc: List: original cargo then the split-off copies.

moveMaterialToDestination.desc: Moves a material cargo to a facility. If the stock cannot take it all, splits: the part that fits is moved, the rest stays in the vehicle.

returns.desc: Cargo handled (the dropped copy in case of a split).
Remaining cargo (nil if everything is dropped).

changeMaterialAmountInFacility.desc: Adds or removes volume to a material's stock in a facility, clamped to [0, capacity] with a logged warning on overflow.

isMixable.desc: Indicates whether a cargo type can be mixed in the same container (parcel: yes, fluid and dryBulk: no).

triggerGenerator.desc: Runs one generation for a generator: parcels (parcelProvider/parcelReceiver), vehicle or trailer offers, or evolution of the material stock.

timeOffset.desc: Time offset (negative to simulate a past generation); 0 by default.

triggerAllGenerators.desc: Triggers all generators whose deadline has been reached (nextGenerationTimestamp), at most once per frame.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: re-arms triggerAllGenerators for the next frame.
